nodes.text: 여보세요? 날씨 봤어? 토요일에 비 온대.
nodes.pron: yeoboseyo? nalssi bwasseo? toyoire bi ondae.
nodes.trans: Hello? Did you see the weather? They say it's going to rain on Saturday.

replies.trans: Really? All day?
Yeah, I saw. That's too bad.

nodes.text: 응, 하루 종일. 그래서 공원 피크닉은 못 하겠다.
nodes.pron: eung, haru jong-il. geuraeseo gong-won pikeunigeun mot hagetda.
nodes.trans: Yeah, all day. So the picnic in the park is off.

replies.trans: Then let's hang out somewhere indoors.
What about Sunday?

nodes.trans: Sunday's going to be sunny, but I have my part-time job that day.

replies.text: 아, 그렇구나. 그럼 토요일에 실내에서 볼까?
replies.pron: a, geureokuna. geureom toyoire sillaeeseo bolkka?
replies.trans: Oh, I see. Then should we meet indoors on Saturday?
Then let's push it to next week.

nodes.text: 그럼 뭐 할래? 영화 볼래, 아니면 카페 갈래?
nodes.pron: geureom mwo hallae? yeonghwa bollae, animyeon kape gallae?
nodes.trans: So what do you want to do? Watch a movie, or go to a café?

replies.trans: Let's watch a movie.
Let's just chat at a café.
Hmm, should we do it another day?

nodes.text: 좋아! 영화 보기 전에 커피 마시자. 영화관 근처에 괜찮은 카페 있어.
nodes.pron: joa! yeonghwa bogi jeone keopi masija. yeonghwagwan geuncheoe gwaenchaneun kape isseo.
nodes.trans: Great! Let's get coffee before the movie. There's a nice café near the theater.

replies.trans: Sounds good.
Sure, I've been wanting a coffee.

nodes.text: 좋아. 역 근처에 예쁜 카페 있어. 거기 가자.
nodes.pron: joa. yeok geuncheoe yeppeun kape isseo. geogi gaja.
nodes.trans: Okay. There's a pretty café near the station. Let's go there.

replies.trans: Sounds good.
Nice, I love cafés.

nodes.text: 몇 시에 만날까? 한 시 어때?
nodes.pron: myeot sie mannalkka? han si eottae?
nodes.trans: What time should we meet? How about one?

replies.trans: One is fine.

replies.text: 조금 늦게 만나도 돼? 세 시쯤?
replies.pron: jogeum neutge mannado dwae? se sijjeum?
replies.trans: Can we meet a bit later? Around three?

replies.text: 미안, 토요일은 안 될 것 같아.
replies.pron: mian, toyoireun an doel geot gata.
replies.trans: Sorry, I don't think Saturday works for me.

nodes.text: 세 시? 응, 괜찮아. 가는 길 알아?
nodes.pron: se si? eung, gwaenchana. ganeun gil ara?
nodes.trans: Three? Sure, that's fine. Do you know how to get there?

replies.trans: No, how do I get there?
Not really. Tell me.

nodes.text: 시청역에서 내려서 삼 번 출구로 나와. 그리고 왼쪽으로 돌아.
nodes.pron: sicheong-yeogeseo naeryeoseo sam beon chulguro nawa. geurigo oenjjogeuro dora.
nodes.trans: Get off at City Hall Station and come out of exit three. Then turn left.

replies.trans: Out of exit three, then left?
Sorry, which exit did you say?

nodes.text: 삼 번 출구. 나와서 왼쪽으로 돌아.
nodes.pron: sam beon chulgu. nawaseo oenjjogeuro dora.
nodes.trans: Exit three. When you come out, turn left.

replies.trans: Got it. Exit three, left.
Okay, I'll write it down.

nodes.text: 응. 그리고 이 분쯤 쭉 와. 카페는 서점 바로 옆이야.
nodes.pron: eung. geurigo i bunjjeum jjuk wa. kapeneun seojeom baro yeopiya.
nodes.trans: Yep. Then walk straight for about two minutes. The café is right next to the bookstore.

replies.trans: Next to the bookstore. Got it!
What does the café look like?

nodes.text: 작고 문이 파란색이야. 바로 보일 거야.
nodes.pron: jakgo muni paransaegiya. baro boil geoya.
nodes.trans: It's small and the door is blue. You'll spot it right away.

replies.trans: A blue door. Got it.
Okay, I'll look for it.

nodes.text: 좋아. 그럼 토요일에 봐! 길 잃으면 전화해.
nodes.pron: joa. geureom toyoire bwa! gil ireumyeon jeonhwahae.
nodes.trans: Great. See you Saturday, then! Call me if you get lost.

replies.trans: Yeah, see you Saturday!

replies.text: 나 조금 늦을 수도 있어. 괜찮아?
replies.pron: na jogeum neujeul sudo isseo. gwaenchana?
replies.trans: I might be a little late. Is that okay?
Thanks. See you then!
Okay, I'll text you.

nodes.text: 그래. 그럼 다음 주 토요일 어때?
nodes.pron: geurae. geureom daeum ju toyoil eottae?
nodes.trans: Sure. Then how about next Saturday?

replies.trans: Next Saturday works.
Let me check and text you.

nodes.trans: Great! Don't forget your umbrella. Bye!

nodes.text: 좋아, 그럼 다음 주 토요일에 봐. 날씨 좋았으면 좋겠다!
nodes.pron: joa, geureom daeum ju toyoire bwa. nalssi joasseumyeon joketda!
nodes.trans: Great, next Saturday then. Hope the weather's nice!
